title: gigachilon polonicum subsp. dicoccoides
intro: Gigachilon polonicum subsp. dicoccoides, commonly known as Polish spelt, is a type of cereal grain that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Polish spelt include its ability to improve digestive health, lower cholesterol levels, and reduce blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
